blocks.t: Global Snapshot of Higher Education and Student Accommodation Segment India’s higher education system is one of the largest globally with around 58,642 institutions, serves approximately 43.3 million students comprising approximately 17.5% of the global enrolments as of AY 202122111. Despite its vast size, the higher education segment is considered under penetrated with a relatively low GER of 28.4%, when compared to select developed and developing economies such as US, UK, Australia, Germany, China and Brazil (estimated to 31.0% by AY 2023-24). …
